scripts.install:all: npm run install:orchestrator && npm run install:mcp && npm run install:web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/orchestrator && npm run build --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm run build --prefix packages/web
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix packages/orchestrator && npm run check --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm run check --prefix packages/web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/orchestrator && npm test --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm test --prefix packages/web
scripts.audit: npm audit --prefix packages/orchestrator --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix packages/mcp-server --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix packages/web --audit-level=high
